information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM3MDMxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--580e15233f5c8e3065f8116ca9163a7eba4d3743/Picture1.png) # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # 멀티 블라인드: 선착순 20명만 참가 가능. # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70901-spectator-restriction)이 존재합니다. WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70897-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70896-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # MBLD: first 20 competitors only. # There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70901-spectator-restriction). If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70897-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SeoulSilentShhpring2026#70896-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions.
